# Diagnostics

Use this skill for the Digital Diagnostic, maturity, findings, and diagnostic
logic. Diagnostics should explain the operating environment, assess digital
and operational maturity, identify findings, connect each conclusion to
evidence, and feed opportunities and approved outputs.

Preserve assessment rationale, evidence links, confidence, assessor/context,
and draft versus approved state. Use an explicit, explainable scoring model;
do not invent arbitrary formulas or generic questionnaires disconnected from
the factory. Make missing evidence and uncertainty visible.

The future Digital Landscape Map should be a projection of structured areas,
processes, systems, data, dependencies, and observations, not a disconnected
drawing. Keep diagnostic logic testable and separate from presentation.
